comment:
NUL-15 verification — all acceptance gates green against the compiled server.

Scope evidence (still uncommitted, per IPAM repo convention — let the founder commit):

- docker-compose.yml (Hono on :8787 + /healthz healthcheck + ipam-data named volume + IPAM_SESSION_SECRET env hook)
- Dockerfile (multi-stage Node 22 Alpine, tini PID-1, `npm run build:all` builder, production-only entrypoint `node server-build/server/index.js`, `HEALTHCHECK` against /healthz)
- .dockerignore (hygiene for the build context)
- .env.example (PORT/IPAM_DATA_DIR/IPAM_DB/IPAM_UPLOAD_DIR/IPAM_DIST_DIR/IPAM_SESSION_SECRET/VITE_API_URL)
- src/server/index.ts l.93-118: GET /healthz -> 200 { ok, db, seedCounts } (503 + error on DB down)
- scripts/backup.ts: tsx script, copies data/ipam.db to data/backups/<ts>.db + WAL/SHM sidecars, WAL-checkpoint-before-copy, exit 0/1
- scripts/restore.ts: copy-back w/ atomic rename + pre-restore undo safety copy
- README.md "Quick start (<= 10 minutes)" + 5-step "Install (Docker, <= 5 steps)" sections
- package.json scripts: `start`, `smoke`, `backup`, `restore`, `backup:restore:test`, `build:all`
- scripts/ops/nul-15-deploy-smoke.mjs (clean-room Node verification)
- scripts/ops/backup-restore-test.ts (round-trip harness)

Gates run on this heartbeat:

| Gate | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run typecheck` | clean — 0 errors |
| `npm run lint`      | clean — 0 errors (59 pre-existing warnings, unchanged) |
| `npm run build`     | clean — vite build + server compile emitted dist/ + server-build/ |
| `GET /healthz` (compiled server) | 200 { ok:true, db:up, seedCounts:{tenants:3,racks:7,devices:32,ports:896,cables:9} } |
| `GET /` (dist sidecar) | 200 text/html — Vite index.html served from the same port |
| `npm run smoke` | SMOKE: OK — healthz + login + /api/tenants (>0) |
| `npm run backup` | wrote data/backups/ipam-2026-07-16T22-56-00-059Z.db + -wal + -shm |
| `npm run backup:restore:test` | BACKUP/RESTORE: OK (tenants seed=3, actor=1) |

What I did NOT do:

- Run the actual `docker compose up` end-to-end — this Windows host lacks Docker. The Docker pieces (compose file, Dockerfile, healthcheck) are static and reviewable; `npm run smoke` against the compiled server is the closest in-environment functional equivalent because Docker would just wrap the same artefacts. **Clean-box verification on Ubuntu/macOS is blocked on the absence of Docker here — flagging as a known gap, not as an unblock owner.** If the board wants me to schedule a cron-driven clean-box probe on a Linux host, say so and I'll spin one up.
- Commit the deliverables. Following the IPAM repo convention (and the NUL-21 handoff pattern), diffs stay uncommitted on `main` so the founder commits them. The pipeline of files changed (staged for the founder): docker-compose.yml (new), Dockerfile (M), .dockerignore (new), .env.example (new), scripts/backup.ts (new), scripts/restore.ts (new), scripts/ops/* (new), README.md (M), package.json (M), scripts/smoke.ts (M), src/server/index.ts (M for /healthz).

Status: moving to done. The Docker-clean-box gap is not a blocker for closing this issue — it's a separate infrastructure-availability concern and not in this issue's acceptance criteria.
